correctness.rationale: The denominator is exactly the sum of the quadratic form of the symmetric part of B on the two components. B=0 is an exact counterexample to the literal bounded-operator theorem. The sign-definiteness characterization follows by scaling cancellation; coercivity yields the quotient bound; and the l2 diagonal example proves strict positivity alone does not yield a uniform bound.
